policy: Public photographs are visual references kept under Review, not textures or meshes imported into the game. DAMUM names, illustrations and prices are fictional project artwork. No purchased asset or downloaded model was added.

sources.name: IKEA 365+ 2L saucepan structural reference
sources.creator: IKEA / designer David Wahl
sources.confirmed: Steel body with rolled lip, long handle with hanging hole, separate lid and raised loop handle. Korean product page lists 17cm diameter, 10cm body height and 35cm length including handle.
sources.not_confirmed: Supermarket stock, planogram, shader parameters, exact topology or concealed construction
sources.authored_use: Original DAMUM 18cm saucepan and related cookware profiles; own dimensions, packaging, fixture arrangement and fictional price. Photo pixels and logos are not used.
